Reviewing the delivered slice in `./repo` with targeted checks. I’ll inspect the touched judge/copilot path and test coverage first, then run a minimal verification pass and fix anything local if I find a bounded defect.
The worktree is dirty in many unrelated areas, so I’m isolating the review to the copilot/judge slice and avoiding unrelated files. Next I’m using explorers to map the backend change, the relevant tests, and whether the frontend actually consumes the new bootstrap payload.
I have the scope narrowed; waiting on the code explorers to avoid redundant file reads. Once they return, I’ll run the smallest set of backend checks that actually exercises the copilot bootstrap payload.
- **Copilot Flow:** Opening the personal‑finance copilot is still just flipping the `#aiCopilotOverlay` visibility (`toggleAICopilot` simply shows/hides the panel, no backend call) and `submitCopilotChat` posts the user’s prompt to `window.FinanceAPI.askCopilot` to render a response via `buildCopilotJudgePayload`. This entire experience lives in `apps/web/src/domains/forecasts/pages/app.js:2970` and the chat submit logic at `apps/web/src/domains/forecasts/pages/app.js:3046`/`app.js:3068–3093`.
- **Connector Scope:** `FinanceAPI` exposes only the `askCopilot` helper (plus news/forecast helpers) and that helper POSTs to `/api/copilot/ask`; there is no mention of `/api/copilot/context` or the `copilot_start` object anywhere in `apps/web/src` (`apps/web/src/domains/forecasts/contracts/apiConnector.js:209–219` and `apps/web/src/domains/forecasts/contracts/apiConnector.js:854` are the only copilot-related code paths).
- **Bootstrapping Gap & Risk:** Because no front-end code logs into `/api/copilot/context`, the new payload that now carries `data.copilot_start.{brief_of_day,ask,open}` never reaches the UI. The overlay does not read `brief_of_day`, nor does it surface the `ask`/`open` action lists, so the UI still relies solely on free‑form questions sent to `/copilot/ask`. That means the new payload can’t bootstrap the initial screen and any consumers of `copilot_start` would require new parsing logic; without it, there’s a mismatch between what the backend now ships and what the current JS shape expects.
- **Next steps:** 
  1. Hook the overlay opening path to fetch `/api/copilot/context`, hydrate a local state with `data.copilot_start`, and render the brief/quick actions before dispatching any `/copilot/ask` requests.
  2. Map `copilot_start.brief_of_day` (summary/timestamps) and the `ask`/`open` arrays into the existing UI components so the judge payload builder can still rely on `answer/confidence/models` when the user selects an action.

Tests not run (not requested).
- **Context Route** `/api/copilot/context` simply wraps `copilot_service.build_context_payload`, forcing the local `ContextService` when available (see `apps/api/src/domains/copilot/api/copilot.py:60`). The payload builder (at `apps/api/src/domains/copilot/application/copilot_service.py:814`) tries to call `ContextService.get_current_market_context`, falls back to `_collect_fallback_context` when that service errors or is missing, ensures requested tickers are echoed under `scope_tickers`, then always appends the daily brief snapshot (`_load_daily_brief_payload` at `:263`) and the two entry points (brief & ask at `_build_copilot_entry_points :320`).  
- **Judge Assembly** The judge intelligence snapshot now guarantees `copilot_start` is present for fresh context and for every cached hit. `_build_copilot_start_payload` (at `apps/api/src/domains/judge/application/intelligence_service.py:270`) produces `brief_of_day`, `ask`, and `open` entries from the stored brief + starter lists, and both the fresh `get_market_context_snapshot` path (starting at `:678`, with the `copilot_start` injection at `:743-752`) and the cache normalizer (`_normalize_market_context` at `:113-139`) call it, so even stale cache files lacking `copilot_start` are backfilled before returning.  
- **Copilot Fallback** When the judge/ContextService path is unavailable, `_collect_fallback_context` (at `apps/api/src/domains/copilot/application/copilot_service.py:128`) builds a market context from local forecast/news snapshots, keeps `key_drivers`/signals non-empty, and `build_context_payload` ensures that fallback flows still get the trimmed daily brief and entry points mentioned above. `ContextService.get_current_market_context` caches its successful output to `data/market_context.json` (`_save_context :524`) and can reload it when a fresh call fails (`_load_cached_context :537`), otherwise defaulting to `_get_fallback_context` (`:572`).  
- **Tests** guard the new guarantees: `apps/api/src/domains/judge/tests/test_intelligence_service_cache.py` (starting at `:24`) asserts a stale cache is refreshed with metadata and `copilot_start`, that a fresh cache lacking `copilot_start` is backfilled (lines `58-103`), and that `copilot_start` always produces non-empty brief/ask/open slots even without a brief (lines `104-115`). `apps/api/src/domains/market_data/tests/test_endpoint_cache_contracts.py:133-184` covers the `/api/copilot/context` fallback path to ensure the fallback note stays and `copilot_start` still exposes `brief_of_day`, an ask stub, and an open target.  
- **Gaps** I didn’t find any existing test hitting the happy `/api/copilot/context` path with a working `ContextService`, so there’s no automated check that a fully populated market context still surfaces `daily_brief`, `entry_points`, and the normalized `copilot_start` blob in the live route. There’s also no targeted verification that `scope_tickers` are preserved or that the daily brief lands with the 200-word trim once storage snapshots are present.  
- **Next Steps** 1) add an integration/contract test that exercises `/api/copilot/context` against the real `ContextService` (or a close mock) to assert `data.copilot_start` plus `daily_brief`/`entry_points` are returned when the judge pipeline succeeds; 2) cover the daily brief normalization (trimmed summary, fallback sources) and the `scope_tickers` copy in `build_context_payload` so we don’t regress the bootstrap metadata that front-end rely on.
The frontend inspection found a concrete integration gap: the UI still never calls `/api/copilot/context`, so the new `copilot_start` payload is not consumed on open. I’m waiting on the backend slice map now, then I’ll verify whether this is a local defect I can fix safely in the existing overlay flow.
The backend slice appears sound and already has targeted tests. The remaining risk is user-visible: opening the copilot still does not hydrate from the new bootstrap payload, so I’m checking the exact overlay/API code now and will patch it if the integration stays as narrow as it looks.
I’ve confirmed the likely user-facing defect is narrow and local to the overlay bootstrap. I’m reading only the exact backend payload builders now so the UI patch matches the real `copilot_start` shape instead of guessing.
I found the concrete gap: backend now serves the bootstrap contract, but the overlay still opens with static content and never fetches it. I’m patching only the overlay/API connector path so open-time behavior matches the delivered backend without broad UI changes.
The patch didn’t apply cleanly because the copilot section in `app.js` has drifted from the expected context. I’m re-reading only the exact edit points and splitting the change into smaller patches so I don’t trample unrelated local work.
The frontend patch is in place. I’m verifying in two layers now: backend contract tests with the correct `PYTHONPATH`, and a syntax smoke check on the touched frontend files so I can tell you whether the fix is at least mechanically safe.
The targeted checks are green so far: backend contract tests passed, and both touched JS files parse cleanly. I’m doing one last pass on the exact diff and a whitespace check so I can return concise proof rather than a file inventory.
I noticed one small UX edge in the new bootstrap flow: after prior chat history, the fresh brief could render above the current scroll position. I’m fixing that locally so opening the copilot reliably lands on the brief instead of the old transcript.
**summary**

PASS after a local bounded fix. QA found the backend bootstrap contract was present, but the web copilot still opened with static content and never fetched `/api/copilot/context`, so the feature did not actually start on the brief of the day. I patched the existing overlay flow to hydrate on open, render the brief plus ask/open actions, and carry starter tickers into `/api/copilot/ask`. Residual risk: no browser E2E/manual UI run in this worker.
